series_title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles vs. Street Fighter
description: When a prestigious martial arts tournament invites fighters to travel to Atlantic City and test their skills, the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles jump at the chance to compete. But a big stage means big competition, and the world famous STREET FIGHTERS have shown up in force to prove the mettle of their PSYCHO POWERED fighting forms. As if that's not enough of a challenge, there are rumors of competitors disappearing and the identity of the contest's benefactors is shrouded in mystery. Don't miss the matchups of your favorite fighters as the half-shell heroes face the likes of Ryu, Guile, Chun-Li, and more. TMNT Vs. Street Fighter kicks off a five-issue fight card of fury starting this May!

series_title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles vs. Street Fighter
description: Brought to you from IDW and Capcom, an event series teaming up two of the greatest martial arts groups in all of pop culture! The World Fighting Festival is serving up heaping helpings of disappointment for both the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles and the Street Fighters.After a devastating loss-on a technicality, no less-a raging Raphael challenges Guile to an unsanctioned rematch in the streets of Atlantic City! Doesn't he know Guile is an actual Street Fighter?! As the Turtles and Street Fighters clash wills and skill on and off the tournament floor, enemies in the shadows conspire against them both!

series_title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles vs. Street Fighter
description: The gloves are off as the Turtles and Street Fighters team up in an all-out brawl against a squad of mysterious mercenaries… But the bout is cut short when key members of both crews are taken captive! Can the remaining TMNT and Street Fighters come together to take down the sinister forces behind the abductions? Or will the plot go unchecked? IDW and Capcom bring the heat once again in this thrilling issue of TMNT Vs. Street Fighter!

series_title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles vs. Street Fighter
description: With Raphael and Chun-Li kidnapped, the remaining members of the TMNT and Street Fighters enter into a shaky truce. But their combined might may not be enough with Baxter Stockman and M. Bison harvesting latent Psycho Power for their own use! Can they find their missing comrades in time?

series_title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles vs. Street Fighter
description: MINISERIES FINALE! The TMNT and Street Fighters stand together against Baxter Stockman and M. Bison at last. Their alliance now set, our heroes’ combined strength should be enough to defeat the bad guys and shut off the Psycho Bomb to save the city. But there’s one variable none of them accounted for: THE SHREDDER has joined the fight! …And his allegiance is to himself.

Crimson Viper is a deadly assassin and well known thief. S.I.N. (Shadaloo Intimidation Network) is very aware of Viper's skill and attempts to recruit her. But Viper has an agenda of her own, and S.I.N.'s infiltration was a part of this. Meanwhile in London, Abel is trying to solve the puzzle of his past, and after beating the hell up of Birdie, he now has a Vincent.

Delve into the secret origins of Seth, the all-new final boss of Street Fighter IV! Who is this powerful figure, and what is his connection to classic characters like M. Bison and Cammy? At the same time Sakura, Dan, and El Fuerte square off against Rufus, the master of mail-order martial arts!

It’s bad girl VS school girl as Crimsom Viper makes Sakura her latest target! How does Sakura fit into the S.I.N. organization’s plan.. and why would they want Dan Hibiki as well? The answers could be DARKER than anyone suspects!

This issue features the epic matchup Seth VS Akuma, plus appearances by Sakura, Dan, C.Viper, Abel, El Fuerte, and more! Also, the issue will feature the first in-story appearance of one of the all-new characters for Super Street Fighter IV(heck, they game won’t even be out until Spring 2010!). So don’t miss it!

All Ibuki wants is a normal Japanese high school experience, but her secret ninja life follows her everywhere she goes! With relentless ninja trainers, deadly Geki assassins, and a crazy karate girl named Makoto all on her case, she’ll be lucky if she even makes it to lunch hour in one piece! Street Fighter Legends: Ibuki is one part ninja action, one part high school antics, and 100% non-stop excitement!

Things get crowded as African fighter Elena joins Makoto and Ibuki in Japan! Can one high school contain three teen girl martial artists? Plus, Ibuki’s ninja training gets taken up a notch! Street Fighter Legends: Ibuki is one part ninja action, one part high school antics, and 100% non-stop excitement!

Ibuki faces her final ninja test – to do battle with the mystical hermit Oro! Does she even stand a chance against one of the greatest martial artists of all time? Probably not… but Makoto and Elena will be there to cheer her on anyways! It’s all out ninja school girl action by writer Jim Zubkavich and artist Omar Dogan. Variant cover by Adam Warren!

Final issue! The ninja schoolgirl adventures of Ibuki come to a roaring conclusion with and all out shuriken-flinging, claw-slicing, fist-throwing ninja war! The residents of the Glade of Ninjas cross blades with the deadly Geki Clan, with Ibuki, Makoto and Elena caught in the middle. Plus, the identity of the mysterious blue ninja is revealed!

Celebrating the 30th Anniversary of Street Fighter, UDON's very first comic story returns as a value-priced 6-issue mini-series! See how Ryu, Guile, Ken, and Chun-li first began their journeys to becoming true World Warriors! Reprints Street Fighter #1 (2003).

Celebrating the 30th Anniversary of Street Fighter, UDON's very first comic story returns as a value-priced 6-issue mini-series! As Chun-li and Guile set their sights on taking down Shadaloo, new World Warriors join the fray - enter Vega, E.Honda, Sakura, and Cammy! Reprints Street Fighter #2 (2003).

Celebrating the 30th Anniversary of Street Fighter, UDON's very first comic story returns as a value-priced 6-issue mini-series! To protect the woman he loves, Ken Masters faces the claws of the vicious Vega! Plus appearances from Akuma, Guile, Chun-li, Zangief, and more! Reprints Street Fighter #3 (2003).

Celebrating the 30th Anniversary of Street Fighter, UDON's very first comic story returns as a value-priced 6-issue mini-series! Chun-li and Guile have tracked down Charlie, but gone is Guile's former friend and mentor. Now there is only... Agent Shadow! Reprints Street Fighter #4 (2003).

Celebrating the 30th Anniversary of Street Fighter, UDON's very first comic story returns as a value-priced 6-issue mini-series! While Sagat challenges Ryu to a rematch and Vega spars with Cammy, Charlie rebels against M.Bison and Shadaloo! Reprints Street Fighter #5 (2004).

Celebrating the 30th Anniversary of Street Fighter, UDON's very first comic story returns as a value-priced 6-issue mini-series! In this final issue, Ryu and Ken come face to face with the deadly Akuma. Will they finally be able to avenge their master's murder? Reprints Street Fighter #6 (2004).

It's Cammy White, the stinging bee of Street Fighter, in her own action-packed comic series! Cammy now leads the all-new special ops team "Delta Blue", as they keep England and the world safe from destructive forces. Whether its art thieves, cyber assaults, or would-be world conquerors, Cammy and Delta Blue are ready to face the enemies of freedom and justice everywhere!

Plus, Chun-li faces a mysterious opponent in a special bonus story.

As Ryu sets out on a dangerous journey to control the dark energies within him, Guile, Cammy and Chun-li confront the remnants of Shadaloo to reveal the truth about Gill's mysterious Secret Society. It's classic Street Fighter warriors at the start of an epic new world-spanning adventure! Collects Issues #1-4 of the Street Fighter Unlimited ongoing comic series, including bonus stories, variant covers, and an all-new 6-page story created exclusively for this volume!

While Ryu fights for survival against the full power of the ancient martial arts master Oro, Gill and the Secret Society reveal the World Warrior Tournament! This contest of champions will gather more fighters in one place than ever before. Ken, Chun-li, and Guile! Ibuki, Makoto, and Elena! Sakura and Karin! Alex and Hugo! Sagat and Adon! Rainbow Mika, Blanka, Necro, Poison, Dan... and so many more! Don't miss the most jam-packed Street Fighter volume ever!

Darkness falls over history's biggest martial arts tournament, as Gill reveals the twisted goals of the Secret Society, Ryu embraces the full power of the Satsui no Hado, and Akuma unleashes the god-like powers of Oni! Is even the combined might of dozens of World Warriors enough to stop these rampaging forces from scarring the Earth?

Bruce Lee never died. And he hasn't aged. But, he has no idea who he is, what's happened in the world in the past 40+ years, or why so many "thugs" want a piece of him. With the help of a fly BFF from the '70s - Joe Toomey, P.I. - and pair of precocious teens, Bruce will piece together a mystery more insidious than ever imagined, and find himself forced to do battle with both an enigmatic Villain and his very own conscience. The Dragon rises... and "walks on" once more! Co-written by Bruce's own daughter, Shannon Lee, and Jeff Kline (Jackie Chan Adventures, Indestructible)!

Bruce Lee never died. Hasn't aged. And has no idea who he is or why so many modern-day "thugs" want to do him harm. Equally perplexing, Bruce finds himself wholly determined to stop a fellow one-time captive from making a splashy reentry into society. But, Bruce's own motives remain a mystery to him, and his plan is precarious, at best. Of course, fists will fly. Villains will plot. And Bruce's best friend, Joe, will... well... be Joe. Can Bruce stop the first domino in Katya's chain from falling? And what does any of this have to do with the shocking discovery that awaits the Teens?

Katya still has "tech titan" Ken Blanchard in her psychic grip - and appears to hold sway over Bruce, as well. Did Nakamura make the Teen's house disappear? Or was it a vengeful Shen? And how is Joe supposed to keep his job when Asst. Manager Hackett is all-seeing and always annoying?

Years ago, a great war between realms brought the universe to the brink of destruction. In their most desperate hour, Earthrealm's champions rallied in strength and spirit—saving their world from the forces of evil. In the years that followed, there existed a peace between realms for the first time since the Mortal Kombat tournaments began. But peace did not last for long...

Scorpion and Raiden must work together to save Takeda from the Neatherrealm's grip. Plus: What happenned to Sub-Zero? And what's REALLY going on with the Kamidogu daggers? All will be revealed!

issue_title: Blood Ties Chapter 12: Rumble In The Jungle

Hanzo Hasashi faces his inner demon—literally—in a mirror-match to save his own soul!
After Scorpion and Havik disappear, all hell breaks loose inside the the throne room! Can Takeda, D'Vorah and the rest of the outworld crew stand against so many champions possesed by blood magik?

description: Frazetta cover on TPB and HC. Collects Seryaku books.

Contents

  • "Lethargic Lad"
  • Heckboy in "Heckboy vs. Toy Pirates!"
  • Self-Indulgent Autobiographical Boy in "A Hard Dates Night!"

Notes:

  • We are introduced to Lethargic Lad and get his "origin" story. He also has various misadventures with some crazy friends. All stories are black and white.
  • The cover is a homage and parody of the cover of Superman #1.

Lethargic Lad faces his most dangerous and horrifying situation ever: he attends a comic book convention! Will he be able to sell enough of his new comic? Will the fans want his autograph? Can he find another super hero to have an 'inter company cross-over' with? Will he be able to 'amalgamize' with some other heroes? In these topsy-turvy days, who can know for sure? Plus, the lethargic adventures continue as Guy-With-A-Gun explores a planet where apes evolved from men and meets up with Walrus Boy 2099! Also, all the other heroes of the Lethargic-verse continue to sit around and drink coffee.

Contents

  • Lethargic Lad works on a farm, while the other Lethargic Lads travel to the Super-Hero picnic.
  • Island Girl and Guy-with-a-Gun-Girl defeat Brother Scud.
  • Guy-with-Claws eats too many beans - an explosion occurs.
  • The heroes ask, "Where was Lethargic Lad?" and embrace Mr. Mimico as their new hero.
  • Friendly Alien Greys agree to return Guy-with-a-Gun to the present day from 2099.
  • The heroes demand the return of Lethargic Lad.
  • A game of Twister will decide who becomes the hero of Infantino City.
  • Guy-with-a-Gun, returned to present day Infantino City, is drop kicked out of a U.F.O., landing on Mr. Mimico, allowing Lethargic Lad to win the Twister contest.

Note

  • The basic plot is a homage and parody of Kingdom Come.
  • The wraparound cover is a homage and parody of Kingdom Come #2 - Truth and Justice., Alex Ross painted Kingdom Come character Norman McCay.

Contents

  • "Lethargic Lad" Story & Art: Greg Hyland
  • Lethargic Team-Up starring Lethargic Lad and HIM in "Episode 5: A New Hope 2" Story & Art: Greg Hyland & Steve Remen

Notes

  • Lethargic Lad Adventures begins story on the front cover.
  • Black & White comic with creator owned content.
  • Stories were preceded by Lethargic Comics; comic is re-titled Lethargic Lad with issue 3.

description: Stunning and graceful, Tucci's rendering talents once again prevail in this latest addition to the Shi story. "Akai" means Red, and Tucci uses this color to celebrate Valentine's Day, and the color of Shi. This issue will tells the story of one of Ana's heroic ancestors, a Shi during the 30's with war on the verge of exploding. Shi: Akai will also be the first-ever appearance of Tucci's newest heroine, RAF Victoria Cross.
Tora No Shi is often translated "Death Tiger"

Shi: The Illustrated Warrior #1 is the vanguard edition of seven monthly issues by Shi creator Billy Tucci and New York Times best-selling author Craig Shaw Gardner (Batman). Combining the very best aspects of Craig's novelized prose and Billy's dynamic and richly detailed illustrations, The Illustrated Warrior is based on the legendary Way of the Warrior story arc, but with an added twist that forever alters the Shi universe we've all come to know. Focusing on Ana's tortured past, first battles and her quest for vengeance, this series goes to great lengths to bring about the most thorough and thought-provoking Shi series ever!

This issue places us alongside Ana Ishikawa as she dons the Sohei battle garb of her ancestors for the first time to avenge the brutal beating of her grandfather, also focusing on Ana's torment as she witnesses the wives and children mourn those she has slain in battle. Ana vows to forego her quest, but now it is the charismatic Yakuza boss Masahiro Arashi who is obsessed with vengeance, recruiting the dark and ruthless warrior monks, the Nara Sohei! The Nara embark on a pilgrimage of blood as they search for a "demon of death" and turn the streets of New York City into an arena of death!

Ana Ishikawa abandons her quest for vengeance and attempts to leave her tortured and murderous past behind. She begins a budding romance with police detective Peter DeNyse and is overjoyed by the unexpected arrival of her best friend, the vivacious and beautiful Tomoe Gozan. But, storm clouds have gathered overhead as Arashi, thirsting for revenge, brings in the most notorious off all assassins - the black-cloaked Nara Sohei. These ruthless warriors have dedicated their lives to the destruction of their centuries-old enemy, the Kyoto Sohei. And Ana has carelessly left behind several clues, all leading to her Kyoto lineage, and the Nara are sent to hunt down the Shi killer. This can only mean one thing: Ana Ishikawa, once the hunter, is now the hunted!

Trying to find some semblance of a normal life and leaving her bloody battles behind, Ana Ishikawa spends an evening reminiscing with her best friend, the vivacious and beautiful Tomoe Gozan. The reunion will be bittersweet however, as unknown to both, Tomoe leads a band of assassins hired to deliver the head of "Shi" to Yakuza crime lord, Masahiro Arashi. While the two share a wonderful evening of wine, Tomoe's Nara warriors wreak havoc across New York City. The Nara are ruthless warriors that have dedicated their lives to the destruction of their centuries-old enemies from Kyoto. Bent on vengeance, these black-cloaked Sohei murder innocents at every corner in an attempt to draw out the Kyoto Sohei known as Shi. Finally Ana once again takes up the naginata, dons her grandfather's kabuki make-up, and attempts to stop these new warriors of death, running into the colossus of Nara itself! A colossus called "Gojira."

The hunter has become the hunted. Yoshitora arrives from Kyoto just in time to save Ana from the Nara behemoth, Gojira. The master Sohei then passes on to Ana the ancient Sohei armor her mother had forsaken, as she attempts to halt the Nara assassins hired to deliver the head of "Shi" to Yakuza crime lord, Masahiro Arashi. Lead by the lethally beautiful Tomoe, the Nara cut a murderous swath through New York as they search for their quarry. And unbeknownst to both Ana and Tomoe, the two friends are on a collision coarse that could destroy their lives!

The time of Battle is upon us. Ana Ishikawa dons the ancient Kyoto armor her mother had forsaken as she attempts to halt the Nara Sohei once and for all. One by one the Nara assassins are sought out and destroyed, and Shi will finally purge New York of such bloodshed. She will duel against the leader of the black-cloaked warriors atop the Queensborough/59th Street Bridge. But Ana's best friend, the lethally beautiful Tomoe, leads the Nara. Tomoe's mantra is that of the butterfly, and she wields her bladed war-fans in a delicate-but-deadly sweep of a song. Bound by honor, a broken-hearted Tomoe must deliver the head of Shi to the ruthless Yakuza crime lord, Masahiro Arashi. Stinging rain and striking lighting slash as embattled friends clash 400 feet above the East River in an incredible dance of death. There will be only one victor, but two lives will be destroyed.

Before Ana can complete her mission of vengeance against the murderous Yakuza Lord Arashi, she must fight by his side against his rebellious samurai. Don't miss this stunning conclusion to the most dramatic and beautifully illustrated Shi series ever.

Shi saves a woman from a mugger in an alleyway, only to discover that they are both vampires when the woman kills the mugger and drinks his blood. Vampirella and Shi cross swords and Shi escapes with Vampirella's bracelet. Vampirella vows to get her bracelet back in seven days.

Shi investigates the bracelet and finds it has an inscription in the ancient language of the Angels which says "I will love you forever - Mother". Using hypnosis, Vampirella uses one of Shi's friends to recover the bracelet, but does not manage to escape unscathed. Injured, Vampirella retires with her bracelet and vows revenge ... one day.
